Close #5595 

## What is the purpose of the change

Add validateSystemTopicWhenUpdateTopic
I checked the relevant source code and it seems that only the test class calls this method(setTransactionOpBatchInterval), which does not feel very necessary
Some other places, such as updateAndCreateStaticTopic, also use TopicValidator#isSystemTopic. Should we deal with them in the same way?

> 

This pr is about `validateSystemTopicWhenUpdateTopic `  instead of  `transactionOpBatchInterval`. Maybe you mistake the changes.
